import pytest
from options import apply_options
@pytest.mark.parametrize('initial,changes', [({'mode': 'safe'}, {'mode': 'fast', 'debug': True}), ({}, {'mode': 'new'}), ({'mode': None}, {'mode': 0})])
def test_rejection_preserves_mapping(initial, changes):
    nested = []
    initial['nested'] = nested
    before = dict(initial)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        apply_options(initial, changes, reject=True)
    assert initial == before
    assert initial['nested'] is nested
